posts.title: Saving macOS disk space with mole
posts.description: Since running agents in a bunch of workspaces, I've been running out of storage on my mac FAR more often. Granted, this is largely due to cargo being such a hog, and I need to run cargo clean more than I do. But it's also due to years of accumulated cruft, all over my machine mole is a pretty neat CLI that can find and clear leftover data 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac

posts.title: Advancing bookmarks with jj
posts.description: A bunch of people read my post about using jj yesterday! In that note I pointed out that I found jj not automatically moving bookmarks when a new commit is created to be really frustrating. Well... turns out there is a really simple command that will do that! It's not automatic, but it's better than manually moving the bookmark jj bookmark advance # or for short jj b a So you can make a new commit
